innes-national-park-9.name: Dolphin Beach
innes-national-park-9.bio: Beach in Innes National Park, on the road that passes the Royston Head Hike car park.
innes-national-park-9.coordinates_source: Median of 3 geotagged Commons files (LOW): the beach is unnamed in OpenStreetMap; the park page places it along the road past the Royston Head Hike car park
innes-national-park-9.notes: Entry is the park's AUD 14.40 per vehicle per day fee (parks.sa.gov.au), carried by the 'innes' park pass at apply. Only one guide source plus the agency's passing mention. No Wikipedia article.

innes-national-park-10.name: Marion Bay
innes-national-park-10.bio: Seaside village at the entrance to Innes National Park, with a beach and fishing charters from the bay.
innes-national-park-10.coordinates_source: OSM place=village node Marion Bay (MEDIUM); Wikipedia -35.2419,136.9782 is the rounded locality point, 740 m off
innes-national-park-10.notes: Town outside the park gate, no entry fee. Fishing charters from Marion Bay per regional guide.

innes-national-park-11.name: Gym Beach Hike
innes-national-park-11.bio: 9.8 km return hike through dunes and mallee from Browns Beach to Gym Beach, with orchids and birdlife.
innes-national-park-11.coordinates_source: Midpoint of OSM way 311691505 'Browns Beach to Gym Beach Hike' (4.9 km one way, matches the park page's 9.8 km return) (MEDIUM)
innes-national-park-11.notes: Park lists 4 hours return. Park entry is AUD 14.40 per vehicle (innes pass). Also part of Walk the Yorke. No Wikipedia article.

innes-national-park-12.name: Thomson-Pfitzner Plaster Trail
innes-national-park-12.bio: Hike along the old wooden railway from Inneston to Stenhouse Bay, with signs on local history and environment.
innes-national-park-12.coordinates_source: Point on the OSM path chain of the trail, about midway between Inneston and Stenhouse Bay (way 327015865 'Thomson-Pfitzner Plaster Trail' continues as way 327015851) (MEDIUM, approximate midpoint)
innes-national-park-12.notes: Park lists 3 hours return, 7.6 km. Park entry AUD 14.40 per vehicle (innes pass). No Wikipedia article.

port-broughton.name: Port Broughton
port-broughton.bio: Gulf-side town with an 1876 T-shaped jetty and a base for fishing charters.
port-broughton.coordinates_source: OSM place=village node Port Broughton (MEDIUM); Wikipedia point is the rounded locality centre
port-broughton.notes: Jetty history from the Wikipedia article; fishing charters from Wikivoyage.

port-broughton-heritage-centre.name: Port Broughton Heritage Centre and Museum
port-broughton-heritage-centre.bio: Local history museum in the town's first school building from 1882, with limited afternoon opening.
port-broughton-heritage-centre.coordinates_source: OSM node at the Harvey Street / Edmund Street intersection; History SA places the museum on that corner and Wikivoyage gives 10 Edmund St (MEDIUM)
port-broughton-heritage-centre.ticket_note: No operator site found; only regional tourism and directory listings, so ticketUrl omitted.
port-broughton-heritage-centre.notes: Adult $7 (Wikivoyage, updated May 2024; tourism listing agrees: concession $5, family $15). Hours conflict: Tue and Thu 1-3pm (History SA, Wikivoyage), Tue 2-4pm (SAcommunity 2022), or by appointment. Confirm before applying. No Wikipedia article.

port-wakefield.name: Port Wakefield
port-wakefield.bio: Gateway town at the head of Gulf St Vincent, with a timber wharf and old sandstone buildings.
port-wakefield.notes: 'Port Wakefield' on Wikipedia is a disambiguation page, so wiki is the full title. Wharf, courthouse and sandstone buildings from Wikivoyage.

walk-the-yorke.name: Walk the Yorke
walk-the-yorke.bio: About 500 km of coastal trail around the Yorke Peninsula, from short strolls to long hikes.
walk-the-yorke.coordinates_source: Point on OSM way 869934325 'Walk the Yorke' on the south-west coast, near the trail's halfway (the trail passes through Innes National Park at the peninsula's tip) (LOW: whole-trail midpoint not computed)
walk-the-yorke.notes: Page loaded and titled 'Walk The Yorke' but it is the regional tourism board's, not the council steward's; owner may prefer to drop it. visitHours are for a day section. Entering Innes National Park on it needs the park vehicle fee.

investigator-strait-shipwreck-trail.name: Investigator Strait Shipwreck Trail
investigator-strait-shipwreck-trail.bio: Trail of interpretive signs at shipwreck sites along the southern Yorke coast, from Edithburgh to Innes.
investigator-strait-shipwreck-trail.coordinates_source: none: sites spread along the coast, no single sourced point
investigator-strait-shipwreck-trail.ticket_note: Many sites, no single steward page found.
investigator-strait-shipwreck-trail.notes: Spread over many sites (the Ethel wreck is already innes-national-park-3), mainly a dive trail. Regional guide says it highlights 10 of the 26 wrecks between Yorke and Kangaroo Island, 1849-1982. Owner may wish to drop it.

unverified: Port Broughton Heritage Centre hours and adult price ($7) from directory listings only
notes: Innes spots carry needs park-pass / parkPass 'innes' per decisions.md; park fee AUD 14.40 per vehicle read from the park page.
